field.label: Enabled
field.help: Enable or disable SSH access for this user.

field.label: Username
field.help: Select an existing OPNsense system user to grant SSH access.

field.label: Auth Method
field.help: Authentication method for SSH login. Key-only is recommended for OT environments.

field.label: SSH Public Key
field.help: Paste the user's SSH public key. Required if auth method is "Key Only" or "Key + Password".

field.label: Shell
field.help: Login shell for this user. "No Login" blocks interactive sessions but allows SCP/SFTP.

field.label: Permission Group
field.help: Role-based access level. Admin: unrestricted. Operator: service management. Viewer: read-only.

field.label: Allowed Networks
field.help: Restrict SSH access to specific source networks (CIDR notation, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24). Empty means all networks are allowed.

field.label: Session Timeout (min)
field.help: Idle timeout in minutes before automatic disconnect. 0 = unlimited (not recommended for OT).

field.label: Max Sessions
field.help: Maximum simultaneous SSH sessions for this user.

field.label: Port Forwarding
field.help: Allow TCP port forwarding / tunneling. Should be disabled in OT environments to prevent zone bridging.
